name: subagent-saver
description: Search subagents (Explore) that were given no model of their own run on a cheaper one instead of the main model. An explicit model, forks, teammates and plugin agents stay untouched. With Claude Code's own CLAUDE_CODE_SUBAGENT_MODEL set (for all subagents), the mod stays out.

model.title: Subagent Saver: model
model.description: Model for the listed subagent types. Sonnet searches nearly as well as Opus; Haiku is cheaper but may miss things, which then costs a second search on the main model.

types.title: Subagent Saver: agent types
types.description: Built-in subagent types to route, comma separated.

language.title: Language
language.description: Language of the texts this mod shows and writes.
